name: transit511
description: 511.org is the San Francisco Bay Area traveler information site. This CLI reads its public transit and traffic data without an API key: transit and traffic alerts, agencies, transit centers, bike share, carpool spots, road speeds and the stop-ID finder.

commands.name: list-transit-alerts
commands.summary: List current Bay Area transit service alerts for all agencies. Filter the output yourself by ServiceAlertEntities[].AgencyId (e.g. BA=BART, SC=VTA, CT=Caltrain, AC=AC Transit).

params.name: road_segments

params.name: road_closed

commands.name: list-transit-agencies
commands.summary: Search Bay Area transit agencies by name and mode. Returns description, modes, the detail-page URL (slug), the stop-ID finder link and the transit-centers link (which carries the agency filter id).

params.name: train
params.description: Pass Train to limit to train agencies

params.name: bus
params.description: Pass Bus to limit to bus agencies

params.name: ferry
params.description: Pass Ferry to limit to ferry agencies

params.name: shuttle
params.description: Pass Shuttle to limit to shuttle agencies

params.name: subway
params.description: Pass Subway to limit to subway agencies (e.g. BART)

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort by name ascending or descending

commands.name: list-transit-agency-codes
commands.summary: List every transit agency with its 2-letter agency code (used in alerts' AgencyId and in the stop-ID finder) and whether it has real-time data.

commands.name: search-transit-centers
commands.summary: Search transit centers and stations by name and/or the agency serving them. Returns names and detail URLs (slug), 10 per page.

params.name: agency
params.description: Numeric agency filter id or All. Take it from the centersUrl of list-transit-agencies, e.g. 146 = AC Transit

commands.summary: Get all transit centers in one JSON list, with address, coordinates, agencies served and shuttles.

commands.name: get-traffic-speeds
commands.summary: Get live traffic flow (speeds, jam factor) for road segments inside a bounding box.

params.name: bbox
params.description: Bounding box west,south,east,north in degrees, e.g. -123.3,36.9,-122.4,37.8

params.name: functionalClasses
params.description: Comma-separated road classes, 1 = major highways up to 5 = local streets

commands.name: search-site
commands.summary: Full-text search of 511.org pages (schedules, agency info, transit centers, programs). Returns page titles and URLs.

notes: No API key is needed. Live departures and stop predictions are not available without one; for those the official 511 open-data API needs a free token.
Agency codes such as BA (BART), CT (Caltrain), AC (AC Transit) and SC (VTA) link alerts, the stop-ID finder and list-transit-agency-codes.
Transit alert times (StartDateTime and EndDateTime) are Unix seconds. Ticker and news dates are MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS local time.
Detail commands take the slug, which is the last path segment of a list result's url.
